cards.d: At the top we see the top hat, and at the bottom a pictographic representation of the folds of a garment. 衤 cloak, 𧘇 scarf.
cards.e: 衣類 의류 clothing, clothes, garment

cards.d: You might think here of garment that have been specially tailored for Thanksgiving celebrations to look like traditional Pilgrim garb.
cards.e: 裁判 재판 trial; 獨裁 독재 dictatorship

cards.d: “Turtle-samurai” sweater. At the top we see the turtle-samurai and at the bottom the element for garment.
cards.e: 包裝 포장 packing, wrapping; 裝飾 장식 decoration, ornament

cards.d: An innocent looking top hat and scarf lying there in front of you, turned over, reveal a hidden computer sewn into the back of each—obviously the tools of a master spy. Such experiences teach one always to have a look at the back side of things.
cards.e: 裏面紙 이면지 scrap paper; 腦裏 뇌리 brain, mind, memory

cards.d: The right half of this character shows a garment woven so fine that it can pass through the eye of a needle, fittingly draped around the slithering, ethereal form of a poltergeist. In this frame, our eerie visitor brushes its robes against a nearby block of apartments and completely demolishes them, razing them to the ground.
cards.e: 破壞 파괴 destruction, demolition

cards.d: A drunken sod in a tattered top hat and soiled silk scarf with a giant mouth guzzling something or other gives us a pathetic character role in which W. C. Fields might find himself right at home
cards.e: 喜怒哀樂 희로애락 joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure; 哀痛하다 애통하다 sad and painful, grieve, deplore

cards.d: A distant figure on the road is such a blur it looks like a lidded crock wearing a silk scarf.
cards.e: 永遠 영원 eternity

cards.d: This clever little monkey has captured an entire pack of wild dogs, locked them inside a lidded crock, and wrapped the whole thing up in a silk scarf to present to the dogcatcher.
cards.e: 類人猿 유인원 antropoid ape

cards.d: In order to make clothes (cloak), you must first start cutting cloth.
cards.e: 初 초 beginning; 初級 초급 primary/elementary grade

cards.d: The basic meaning of this primitive is a bolt of cloth, from which we derive the meaning of a towel.
cards.e: 手巾 수건 towel

cards.d: The maid, towels by her side, distributes the linen.
cards.e: 分布 분포 distribution; 瀑布 폭포 waterfall

cards.d: A sail made of a towel makes a mediocre vessel.
cards.e: 出帆 출범 launch; 帆船 범선 sailboat, sailer

cards.d: A hanging scroll is one of the many traditional ways to display and exhibit Chinese painting and calligraphy. The painting surface of the paper or silk can be mounted with decorative brocade silk borders. Hanging scrolls are art, they are NOT towels of the wealthy. You may find a hanging scroll hanging like a towel in a wealthy persons bathroom but don't dry yourself with it.
cards.e: 幅넓다 폭넓다 wide, broad

cards.d: Because of the risk involved (of getting the sun in one’s eyes), one puts together a makeshift cap out of a dirty old towel.
cards.e: 帽子 모자 cap

cards.d: A dirty towel draped over the entrance to the old graveyard is painted to look like the curtain of death that leads to the other world.
cards.e: 字幕 자막 subtitles; 幕間 막간 intermission; 開幕 개막 raising of the curtain, start of performance

cards.d: A large towel stretched overhead with only a few of the sun’s rays breaking through represents a canopy over one’s bed.
A strip of white towel and some scraps of metal have the makings of a primitive kind of brocade.
cards.e: 錦上添花 금상첨화 icing on the cake; 錦江 금강 Geum River

cards.d: Dressed in nothing but a bath towel and top hat, one sets off to the marketplace in search of a bargain or two
cards.e: 都市 도시 city; 市場 시장 market

cards.d: Of all the women of the family, it is the elder sister who has the duty to go to market to do the shopping.
cards.e: 姊妹 자매 sisters; 姊兄 자형 elder sister's husband

cards.d: One is surprised, strolling through the market, to find among the meats hung out for sale a slab marked: lungs.
cards.e: 肺炎 폐렴 pneumonia, inflammation of the lungs

cards.d: 帀/匝/迊 Wrapping around with a towel.
The buckle of the sash is represented pictorially by the first 5 strokes.
cards.e: 携帶폰 휴대폰 cell phone; 一帶 일대 while area/district; 熱帶 열대 tropics

cards.d: People that have been “sashed” to something (whether their mother’s apron strings or a particular job) for too long become like water that has stopped moving: they start to stagnate.
cards.e: 延滯 연체 delay, procrastination, arrears

cards.d: Thorns grow on a bush here that has wrapped itself around a tree like a belt, cutting into the poor tree like little sabers.
cards.e: 刺戟 자극 stimulus, stimulation, irritation

cards.d: This kanji show a unique system for leading cows to the slaughterer’s saber: one ties a belt about their waist and fixes that belt to an overhead cable, pulling the cow up into the air where it hangs suspended, helpless against the fate that awaits it.
cards.e: 制度 제도 system, institution; 強制 강제 compulsion, coercion; 節制 절제 moderation, temperance, continence

cards.d: A label indicating that a garment was made in U.S.A. or Taiwan or Japan is itself a symbol for the systematization of the garment industry.
cards.e: 製作 제작 manufacture, production

cards.d: This primitive is meant to depict in graphic fashion a cloud of something or other rising upwards, like vapor or smoke or dust.
cards.e: 云云 운운 and so on, and the like; 云云하다 운운하다 say such and such

cards.d: As the wheels of the car revolve, they kick up small rising clouds of dust and debris behind them.
cards.e: 運轉 운전 driving

cards.d:
I've mastered a technique for making my farts (the cloud) smell like roses (the flower).
The contemporary art is very strange, it can call a ordinary object to be a object of art. So is it here: a fat and round 丸 clod of earth 坴 with mushrooms 圥 and grass that emits clouds of fresh soil scent. What does it mean? Mother nature?
cards.e: 藝術 예술 art

cards.d: The top line is the sky, the next 3 strokes a pair of clouds, and the final 4 dots the rain collected there and waiting to fall.
cards.e: 雨傘 우산 umbrella

cards.d: Here is the full character for cloud from which the primitive for a rising cloud derives. Clouds begin with vapors rising up in small clouds from the surface of the earth, and then gathering to make clouds that eventually dump their rain back on the earth.
cards.e: 星雲 성운 nebula; 風雲 풍운 wind and clouds

cards.d: We refer to days when the sun is covered by the clouds as cloudy weather.
The full rumble and roar and terror of thunder is best felt not with your head tucked under your pillow safe in bed, but out in an open rice field where you can get the real feel of the weather.
cards.e: 機雷 기뢰 sea mine; 魚雷 어뢰 torpedo

cards.d: Think of frost as a cooperative venture, an inter-action of the malevolent forces of weather that sit around a conference table and finally decide to allow a very light amount of moisture to fall just before a short and sudden freeze.
cards.e: 雪上加霜 설상가상 to make matters worse; 風霜 풍상 wind and frost

cards.d: The condensation of the three drops we have been using to mean water into two drops signals the solidifying of water into ice.
Walking legs slipping on the ice are a sure sign of winter.
cards.e: 冬季 동계 winter season; 冬服 동복 winter clothes, winter wear;  春夏秋冬 춘하추동 the four seasons

cards.d: This character is meant to be a pictograph of a great man, said to represent the Lord of the Heavens.
cards.e: 天國 천국 Paradise, 天障 천장 ceiling

cards.d: The sense of the primitive, angel, derives from the primitive for heavens replacing the top hat in the character for tall.
cards.e: 喬木 교목 tall tree, arbor

cards.d: The bridge shown here is made of trees in their natural form, except that the trunks have been carved into the forms of angels, a sort of “Ponte degli Angeli.”
cards.e: 陸橋 육교 pedestrian overpass; 大橋 대교 big bridge

cards.d: Associating a particularly attractive woman you know with an angel should be no problem.
cards.e: 愛嬌 애교 charms, attractiveness
